ssdts.name: SSDT-PLUG.aml
ssdts.source: Dortania extra-files (PLUG-DRTNIA) until you load a machine file
ssdts.description: Attaches X86PlatformPlugin for native CPU power management on Haswell and newer Intel. The generic/T5810 AML is wrong for a dual-socket T7910 — load SSDTTime SSDT-PLUG from that machine.
ssdts.when: Intel Haswell+ desktop, HEDT, laptop

ssdts.name: SSDT-PLUG-ALT.aml
ssdts.description: Alternate plugin-type SSDT for odd CPU ACPI order (some Alder / Arrow hybrid boards).
ssdts.when: Only if SSDT-PLUG does not attach X86PlatformPlugin

ssdts.name: SSDT-EC-USBX.aml
ssdts.description: Hides the OEM Embedded Controller, injects a fake EC, and adds USBX power properties. Standard desktop / HEDT pick.
ssdts.when: Skylake+ desktop, X99, X299, AMD desktop

ssdts.name: SSDT-EC.aml
ssdts.description: Fake EC only, no USBX. Used on pre-Skylake desktops alongside EC-USBX. T5810 and T7910 need their own SSDTTime EC — do not keep the T5810 file on a T7910.
ssdts.when: Haswell/Broadwell desktop, Dell X99

ssdts.name: SSDT-EC-LAPTOP.aml
ssdts.description: Laptop EC stub that does not disable the real Embedded Controller (battery / hotkeys).
ssdts.when: Laptops only — do not mix with SSDT-EC-USBX desktop

ssdts.name: SSDT-EC-USBX-LAPTOP.aml
ssdts.description: Laptop fake EC plus USBX without killing the real EC.
ssdts.when: Laptops

ssdts.name: SSDT-HPET.aml
ssdts.source: SSDTTime (T5810 download until you load a T7910 file)
ssdts.description: IRQ / HPET conflict fix. Needed for onboard audio on many boards. Enabling this also turns on the ACPI patches: HPET _CRS→XCRS, TMR IRQ 0, RTC IRQ 8. The downloaded AML is from the single-socket T5810 — load SSDTTime output from the T7910 itself so this file is machine-correct.
ssdts.when: Dell T5810/T7910, or any board SSDTTime flagged for HPET

ssdts.name: SSDT-SBUS-MCHC.aml
ssdts.description: Adds SMBus / MCHC so AppleSMBus attaches. Skip if your DSDT already has MCHC.
ssdts.when: X99 / many desktops missing MCHC

ssdts.name: SSDT-X99-USBX.aml
ssdts.source: BillDH2k T5810 EFI — leave OFF with T7910 USBX
ssdts.description: T5810 USBX that calls DTGP. The old T5810 SSDT-SBUS-MCHC defined DTGP; our T7910 SBUS does not. Loading this with the new SSDTs causes ACPI Error: [DTGP] AE_NOT_FOUND. Use SSDT-EC-USBX instead (same USB power properties, no DTGP).
ssdts.when: Do not enable on T7910 if SSDT-EC-USBX is on

ssdts.name: SSDT-RTC0-RANGE.aml
ssdts.description: Fills RTC _CRS holes so Big Sur and newer will boot on X99 / X299. Required on HEDT. Generate from this machine on a T7910; the T5810 range table is a last-resort fallback.
ssdts.when: X99, X299, C612, Skylake-X

ssdts.name: SSDT-RTC0.aml
ssdts.description: Fake RTC device when firmware has no legacy RTC. Use instead of AWAC only when AWAC disable is wrong.
ssdts.when: 300-series boards where SSDT-AWAC is not enough

ssdts.name: SSDT-AWAC.aml
ssdts.description: Forces the legacy RTC and disables AWAC. Needed on most 300-series and newer desktops.
ssdts.when: Coffee Lake and newer Intel desktop (not HEDT X99)

ssdts.name: SSDT-UNC.aml
ssdts.description: Disables unused uncore PCI bridges so IOPCIFamily does not stall on Big Sur+. Required on X99 / C612.
ssdts.when: X99, C612, older HEDT. Not on Skylake-X Dortania list

ssdts.name: SSDT-PMC.aml
ssdts.description: Maps PMC MMIO so NVRAM works on true 300-series. Do not use on Z370.

ssdts.name: SSDT-RHUB.aml
ssdts.description: Resets the USB root hub so ports enumerate. Common on Asus 400-series, Ice Lake, and some AMD.
ssdts.when: Missing USB ports in macOS, Asus 400, AMD USB reset

ssdts.name: SSDT-PNLF.aml
ssdts.description: Backlight device for laptops and AIOs. WhateverGreen needs this for brightness keys.
ssdts.when: Laptop / iMac-style AIO with iGPU

ssdts.name: SSDT-IMEI.aml
ssdts.description: Creates an IMEI device when the CPU and chipset generation are mixed (Sandy CPU + 7-series, Ivy CPU + 6-series).
ssdts.when: CPU/chipset generation mismatch only

ssdts.name: SSDT-CPUR.aml
ssdts.description: Adds CPU ACPI objects missing on AMD B550 / A520. Do not use on X570 or Intel.
ssdts.when: AMD B550 / A520 only

ssdts.name: SSDT-XOSI.aml
ssdts.description: Spoofs _OSI so Windows-only ACPI methods run. Needs a matching DSDT _OSI → XOSI rename. Do not add without that patch.
ssdts.when: Board ACPI gated behind Windows _OSI — plus the rename

ssdts.name: SSDT-ALS0.aml
ssdts.description: Fake ambient light sensor. Optional; some brightness setups want it.
ssdts.when: Laptop brightness / auto-brightness experiments

ssdts.name: SSDT-BRG0.aml
ssdts.description: PCI bridge ACPI for GPUs sitting behind an extra bridge. Rare; only if device-id injection cannot see the dGPU.
ssdts.when: dGPU behind a PCI bridge that macOS does not walk

ssdts.name: SSDT-PCI1.aml
ssdts.description: Experimental second-CPU PCI bus table for the dual-socket T7910. There is no T5810 equivalent. Load the AML from the T7910 ACPI thread; leave off unless that bus is missing in macOS.
ssdts.when: Dell T7910 second socket PCI — optional / experimental

ssdts.name: SSDT-PCIA.aml
ssdts.description: Experimental PCI0/PCIA helper for the T7910's second CPU root bridge. Load the machine AML; do not expect a Dortania download.
ssdts.when: Dell T7910 second socket PCI — optional / experimental
